title: Sony ends physical disc production for new PlayStation games from 2028
question: How will PlayStation players react to this over the first two weeks, which groups will push back and why, and is Sony likely to keep, change or reverse the decision?

objections.text: Digital-only means players no longer own their games and cannot resell, lend or trade them
It threatens game preservation, since digital titles can vanish when servers or licences end
It hurts the used-game market and independent retailers
Boxes holding a download code are not a substitute because codes cannot be resold

backdown.summary: Sony's CFO restated the plan on 31 July 2026 and said it would proceed cautiously; it only noted that boxed products with download codes remain possible

notes: The backlash lasted unusually long: an organised #PSBlackout boycott (23-30 Aug) and chat protests during the 3 Sep State of Play. Sony said the backlash had not hurt the business. A prediction of an organised boycott with no reversal scores well.
